name: NHANES: HbA1c → fasting glucose
source: NHANES 2017-2018 (CDC), adults in the fasting subsample
citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017-2018.
split_description: fixed 80/20 split (seed 0); the 20% is validation data used to choose a stopping round

linear.reference_description: training-set average of every column (a mathematical reference, not a real person)

boosting.init_description: round 0: the average outcome in the training rows

comparison_learning_rate_0_02.note: a separately fitted model with learning_rate=0.02; not a rescaled copy of the main model
